prompt.objetivo: Design the persistence the current SRS needs. Relational or document, according to the problem and the stack already chosen.

hacer.paso: Extract entities, documents, or events from the current requirements. Do not add aggregates that no requirement uses.
If the project already has a schema, start from that schema and mark the changes. Do not replace it with an ideal model disconnected from it.

Deliver a conceptual, logical, and physical model. Relational: keys, cardinalities, uniqueness, integrity, justified indexes, and a deletion policy. Document: collections, keys, indexes, validations, and access patterns.
Include a Mermaid diagram and a short dictionary in the same document, with a link to formats/database/DATA_DICTIONARY.md if the dictionary grows.
Propose versioned migrations only as a design. Do not execute them in this phase.
Personal data, retention, and least privilege are explicit when the SRS implies them.

no_hacer.regla: Do not force PostgreSQL, and do not force MongoDB, if the current document already chose an engine.
Do not normalize or denormalize without saying which query or which integrity rule justifies it.
Do not invent billing, audit, or multi-tenant tables if the current business model does not require them.
